title: Fix Every Match
description: Learn how to change the next search match and repeat that exact fix on the one after it.

workspace.f.txt:
please fix: todo todo todo
also: TBD TBD
and: xxx

success.content:

and: yyy

objective: Every 'todo' needs to become 'done' — fix the first match, then repeat that exact fix on the rest without re-selecting anything.
